an3.9:1.1: tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an3.9:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti, sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an3.9:2.1: tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito vyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti, ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca puññaṃ pasavati.
an3.9:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito vyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti, ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca puññaṃ pasavatīti.
